item.title: Sarah Hardwig Showcases Her ‘Natural Gift’ With Inspiring Audition on ‘AGT’: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trending stories. Today, we're shining the spotlight on Sarah Hardwig, a talented singer who's making waves on America's Got Talent.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Born blind with a genetic eye condition, Leber's Congenital Amaurosis, Sarah has never let her disability hold her back. The 23-year-old from Nashville, Tennessee, recently covered Lainey Wilson's "Heart Like A Truck" on AGT, and her performance was truly unforgettable.
[Clip of judges' comments plays]
Host: The judges were blown away by Sarah's talent and resilience. Howie Mandel called her performance "beautiful and heartwarming," while Spice Girl Mel B praised her voice and control. Sofia Vergara simply said, "Everything you did was amazing." Even Simon Cowell was impressed, saying, "You really, really have a natural gift."
[Soft music continues]
Host: Sarah's audition earned her four "yeses" from the judges, a standing ovation from the crowd, and a spot in the next round of the competition. But this isn't her first taste of success. She's already won the Tennessee Songwriters Showcase, performed at the Country Music Hall of Fame, and even made her debut at The Grand Ole Opry.
[Outro music starts]
Host: Catch Sarah's incredible audition on America's Got Talent, airing Tuesday evenings on NBC and streaming on Peacock the next day. We can't wait to see what's next for this talented singer. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast, and we'll see you next time!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
